title: Script Policy Agent Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Arm Projects
description: Sort eight situations into three kinds of control: a script, a learned policy or an agent. The deciding question is who chooses the next move: fixed code, a trained model, or a language model choosing tools. Used in Chapter 18.

educational.topic: Script, learned policy and agent: three ways of deciding what the arm does next
learningObjectives: Differentiate eight situations as a script, a learned policy or an agent, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Separate things that look alike by asking who decides each move, with the correct kind and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Where did the knowledge come from?
commonMisconceptions: A camera makes a program an agent
Anything with a neural network is an agent
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classifications; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next situation / See score / Try again
